lead: One message in a chat: the assistant's is "avatar + content column", the user's a bubble on the right. The content can hold Markdown, sources and tool calls, with a row of faded actions below. Each message is a named article, so inside a Chat Thread a screen reader can read them one by one.

usage.title: Usage
usage.question: How do I validate a form?
usage.answer: Use a schema and validate on submit.

markdown.title: With Markdown
markdown.reply:
Sure! Here is a quick plan:

1. **Parse** the input
2. **Validate** each field
3. Return a typed result

```ts
const result = validate(parse(input));
```

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: The actions stay faded until the message is hovered or focused with the keyboard (always shown on touch screens); toggles such as Like use `pressed`.
actions.message: Hover (or focus) this message to reveal the actions.

grouped.title: Consecutive messages
grouped.description: In a run of assistant messages only the first shows the avatar; the others pass `show={false}` to keep an empty slot, so the text stays aligned.
grouped.second: Second message, aligned with the first.

edit.title: Edit and resend
edit.description: Click the pencil to edit: ⌘ / Ctrl + Enter saves, Esc cancels, empty text can't be saved.

pager.title: Response versions
pager.description: After regenerating, one question has several replies: `Pager` switches between the versions.
pager.v0: Use a schema and validate on submit.
pager.v1: Validate on blur, and show inline errors as the user types.
pager.v2: Prefer a library: it gives you schemas, async rules and typed errors.

status.title: Status and time
status.description: A failed send is `role=alert` and can be retried; once sent, a timestamp takes its place.

api.title: API Reference
api.Assistant: The root of an assistant message: an `article` with a name (`aria-label`, "Assistant" by default).
api.User: The root of a user message: an `article` with a name (`aria-label`, "You" by default).
api.Avatar: The assistant's avatar (`src` / `alt` / `fallback`). In a run of assistant messages, the later ones pass `show={false}`: an empty slot of the same width keeps the text aligned.
api.Actions: A row of action buttons (`role=group`, `aria-label` "Message actions" by default). Faded until the message is hovered or focused; always shown on touch screens.
api.Action: An icon button (a small, muted Button); `aria-label` is required. `pressed` is written as `aria-pressed`, for Like / Dislike.
api.Edit: A form to edit a user message: put it in `ChatTurn.User` instead of `Bubble`. `defaultValue` / `onSave(value)` / `onCancel`. It grows with its text, Enter adds a line, ⌘ / Ctrl + Enter saves, Esc cancels, it takes focus when mounted, and empty text can't be saved; `labels` changes the button texts.
api.Pager: Switches between the reply versions of one question ("‹ 2 / 3 ›"): `index` counts from 0, nothing renders under 2 versions, the direction at either end is disabled, and changes are announced. Put it in `Actions`.
api.Status: The message's send state: `sending` is `role=status`, `failed` is `role=alert` and can be retried.
api.Time: A timestamp: `<time datetime>`, formatted for `locale` (the ConfigProvider's by default), with the full date as `title`; `display="datetime"` includes the date.
